question: The state government of which of the following states, in September 2025, mandated a child protection policy in all residential schools and hostels?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Karnataka state government** mandated a **child protection policy** in all residential schools and hostels in **September 2025**. This decision was aimed at ensuring the safety and welfare of children in educational institutions.
 
• The **policy** was introduced to address concerns over **child abuse, neglect, exploitation, and harassment** in residential schools and hostels, promoting a safe learning environment for children.
 
• The mandate specifically applies to **all government-run and private residential schools** and hostels, ensuring uniformity in safeguarding measures across the state.
 
• Key features of this policy include **regular inspections**, **mandatory background checks** for staff, and the establishment of **internal committees** to address grievances and ensure accountability.
